description: This PHP source file defines the 'Forgotten' class within the OpenCart framework, responsible for handling password reset email notifications. It loads necessary models and languages, verifies input arguments, retrieves customer info, and queues an email task regarding password reset.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Handles the process of sending password reset emails in the OpenCart application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to process password reset requests, generate email content, and queue email sending tasks.
